_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante (segments regules), puis rate base regulatory drivers, fin par production.

kpis.signal: Croissance reguliere post-spinoff Constellation (2022), portee par rate cases approves et hausse loads
kpis.description_fr: Total revenus operationnels Exelon (pure utility regulee post-spin Constellation Fev 2022). Combine electricite + gaz + alternative revenue programs. Mesure top-line.
kpis.description_en: Exelon total operating revenues (pure regulated utility post-Constellation spin Feb 2022). Combines electric + gas + alternative revenue programs. Top-line measure.
kpis._specific_to: Exelon regulated utility top-line (FY21 = continuing ops basis only)

kpis.signal: ComEd = plus grosse filiale (Illinois/Chicago). Baisse 2025 reflete passthroughs purchased power, rate base toujours en hausse
kpis.description_fr: Revenus operationnels ComEd, plus grande filiale d'Exelon. Couvre region Chicago/Illinois. Rate cases sous compteur (Illinois 2023 Electric Distribution).
kpis.description_en: ComEd operating revenues, Exelon's largest subsidiary. Covers Chicago/Illinois region. Active rate cases (Illinois 2023 Electric Distribution).

kpis.signal: Hausse forte 2025 grace au Pennsylvania 2024 Electric Distribution Base Rate Case approuve
kpis.description_fr: Revenus PECO Energy (Philadelphie). Electricite + gaz naturel. Rate case PA 2024 effectif 2025.
kpis.description_en: PECO Energy revenues (Philadelphia). Electric + natural gas. PA 2024 rate case effective 2025.

kpis.signal: Hausse acceleree 2024-2025, Maryland 2023 multi-year rate case (Electric + Gas) actif
kpis.description_fr: Revenus Baltimore Gas & Electric (Maryland). Electricite + gaz. Multi-year rate plan Maryland 2023 en vigueur.
kpis.description_en: Baltimore Gas & Electric revenues (Maryland). Electric + gas. Maryland 2023 multi-year rate plan in effect.

kpis.signal: PHI = Pepco + Delmarva + Atlantic City Electric. Croissance soutenue via rate cases multi-juridictions (DC, MD, NJ, DE)
kpis.description_fr: Revenus consolides Pepco Holdings: Pepco (DC + Maryland), Delmarva Power (DE + MD), Atlantic City Electric (NJ). Multi rate cases actifs.
kpis.description_en: Pepco Holdings consolidated revenues: Pepco (DC + Maryland), Delmarva Power (DE + MD), Atlantic City Electric (NJ). Multiple active rate cases.

kpis.signal: Cle business, ~93% des revenus. Croissance regulee, rate base expansion (+T&D investments)
kpis.description_fr: Revenus electricite reglementee Exelon (toutes filiales). Distribution + transmission. ~93% du CA total. Driver structurel rate base growth.
kpis.description_en: Exelon regulated electric revenues (all subsidiaries). Distribution + transmission. ~93% of total revenue. Structural rate base growth driver.

kpis.signal: Segment minoritaire (PECO + BGE + DPL). Volatilite prix matieres + rate cases gaz
kpis.description_fr: Revenus gaz naturel Exelon (PECO PA, BGE MD, Delmarva). Distribution gaz reglementee. Bond 2025 lie passthroughs + PA/MD gas rate cases.
kpis.description_en: Exelon natural gas revenues (PECO PA, BGE MD, Delmarva). Regulated gas distribution. 2025 jump from passthroughs + PA/MD gas rate cases.
